objectives.description: Identify and describe the main parts of a computer (CPU, input/output devices, storage devices) and their functions
Distinguish between hardware and software and classify software into system and application types
Describe types of storage devices (hard disk, SSD, flash drive, memory card) and their capacities
Apply correct typing posture, keyboard technique, and use alphanumeric, function, and service keys
Describe types and speeds of computer networks (LAN, WAN, MAN) and explain how they function
Use word processing software to create, format, edit, and save documents
Enter and edit data in a spreadsheet, create formulas, and generate simple charts
Format cells, save, and retrieve spreadsheet files in Microsoft Excel or equivalent
Create, format, and present slides in presentation software (Microsoft PowerPoint or equivalent)
Add pictures, audio, video, transitions, and animations to presentation slides
Print and save presentations and documents in appropriate formats

subStrands.name: Online Research, Email, and Digital Safety

objectives.description: Describe the internet, its uses, and identify reliable search engines and web browsers
Use search engines effectively to find, evaluate, and cite online information
Compose, send, receive, and manage emails as a digital communication tool
Describe digital safety measures including secure passwords, avoiding cyberbullying, and malware protection
Explain digital ethics including intellectual property, copyright, plagiarism, and responsible use of social media
Describe cyber laws, digital rights, and online privacy practices
Describe emerging technologies including Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Internet of Things at an introductory level
Explain basic concepts of Blockchain and Cloud Computing and their applications in society
Identify career opportunities in ICT (software developer, data analyst, network engineer, cybersecurity specialist, graphic designer)
Design and present a capstone digital project (website prototype, database, digital media production, or simple program)
Edit digital media including basic image cropping/resizing, audio trimming, and video clip assembly
